mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notification (user_id, type, content, target_type, target_id, is_read, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_notification SET is_read = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
